items.text:
it genuinely cant be recommended in this state.  ive had items go into a black hole on my ship when moving things with shift[causing unplayable lag], ive had the transit hubs break down and refuse access [effectively trapping you isolated pockets on a station]  ive had police officers flag me down for illegal ship ripping only for them to get back in their chair and fly my ship into a old wreak at 900 meters/s instantly breaking everything, ive been moving in to dock at the station only for the game to freeze up while the ship is barely moving, for it to unfreeze and ram it into the docking platform so hard it ripped several holes in the walls on very far distance locations[ on a fairly large ship]

that one is actually really annoying, ive messed up and crashed at substantially faster speeds and never even had a hull breach

, causing the equivelant of approximatley 20minutes of idle repairs [actual time in a sped up speed] 

but they do seem to listen to feedback. i remember an older version where it didnt really feel like your in space, removing floor felt like removing your ability to even move around a station/ ship. now you can actually fly over empty tiles and against the ship itself without a floor 

its just got too many big problems for you to enjoy  a good time
items.text_zh:
就目前这个状态，真的没法推荐。我用shift移动东西时，物品会掉进飞船上的黑洞里[导致卡得没法玩]，交通枢纽会坏掉并拒绝通行[实际上把你困在空间站的孤立区域里]，警察会因为非法拆船把我拦下来，结果他们却坐回椅子上，以900米/秒的速度把我的飞船撞向一艘旧残骸，瞬间把所有东西都撞坏了，我正慢慢靠近空间站准备停靠，结果游戏卡住了，飞船几乎没在动，等它恢复过来，飞船猛地撞上停靠平台，在很远的位置[在一艘相当大的飞船上]把墙壁撞出了好几个洞

那一次真的特别烦人，我以前以快得多的速度撞毁过，却连船体都没破过

，造成了大约相当于20分钟闲置修理的后果[按加速后的实际时间算]

但他们似乎确实会听取反馈。我记得有个旧版本，感觉不太像是在太空中，拆掉地板就像剥夺了你在空间站/飞船上走动的能力。现在你实际上可以飞过空地块，也可以在没有地板的情况下贴着飞船本身飞行

只是它的大问题太多了，让你没法好好享受一段愉快的时光
